Fitness HQ is a trading style of Skills College UK (www.scuk-ltd.co.uk) 

We are a nationally and internationally recognised Training Provider delivering a wide range of fitness qualifications such as Personal Trainer Courses, Sports Massage Courses and Nutrition Qualifications throughout the UK.

Our exercise and fitness tutors have over 40 years industry experience between them and as well as deliver these nationally recognised qualifications, our tutors have successful Personal Training and / or Sports Massage Therapy businesses of their own. 

For more information don't hesitate to call us on 01925 506 507 or visit our website at www.fitness-hq.co.uk
